cues: Raise it to ten, and you get sixty point two percent.
So why not squeeze even more?
Above about ten, the petrol air mixture gets so hot that it explodes on its own before the spark.
That is called knocking, and it limits petrol engines to ratios of about eight to ten.
Real ones manage only twenty five to thirty percent, because of friction, heat loss and incomplete burning.
